realism.check: Warehouse-supplied items are off the shelf 3-14% of open hours
realism.detail: 5.0% of open hours across 7 items in June
realism.source: FMI, GMA and CIES (2002), worldwide out-of-stock study: average 8.3%; about 47% from store ordering and forecasting, 25% from shelf management

realism.check: Most out-of-stock hours start in the store (at least 60%)
realism.detail: 74% in the store; shelf and backroom 62%, store ordering and stock records 12%, upstream supply 26%
realism.source: FMI, GMA and CIES (2002), worldwide out-of-stock study: average 8.3%; about 47% from store ordering and forecasting, 25% from shelf management; McKinnon, Mendes and Nabateh (2007): 70-90% from shelf replenishment

realism.check: Most item records are wrong at the month-end count (40-85%)
realism.detail: 8 of 11 items differ: ATTA-WW-5KG -1, ATTA-WW-1KG +1, RICE-SM-5KG -2, OIL-SUN-1L -8, SUGAR-1KG -1, MILK-TONED-500ML -55, MILK-FC-500ML +48, CURD-500G -3
realism.source: DeHoratius and Raman (2008), Management Science 54(4): 65% of 370,000 records inaccurate

realism.check: Shoppers facing an empty shelf respond in the studied proportions (within 7 points)
realism.detail: 1021 empty-shelf encounters; other_pack 14%, other_brand 26%, delay 15%, elsewhere 37%, skip 9%
realism.source: Gruen, Corsten and Bharadwaj (2002), as charted by Penn (SAEA): substitute about 45%, switch stores about 31%, delay about 15%, do not buy about 9%. The split of substitution between pack size (19%) and brand (26%) is our assumption

realism.check: Sales of an item never exceed its own demand (plus substitutes)
Pouch milk is sellable on the delivery day and the next (48 hours from packing)
realism.detail: use-by minus delivery date: [1] day(s) over 112 deliveries
realism.source: Amul Taaza pouch milk: 48 hours from packing under refrigeration below 8 degC

realism.check: Every goods receipt matches a shipping-notice pallet and comes after dispatch
Every shipping-notice line has a matching pick confirmation and pallet record
realism.detail: 0 of 137 notice lines without a matching pick or pallet

realism.check: The DC truck makes its 06:00-06:30 slot on most mornings (85%+)
realism.source: assumption: share of mornings the DC truck misses its 06:00-06:30 slot

realism.check: GTINs, GLNs and SSCCs carry valid check digits under the restricted prefix 29
realism.source: GS1 GSCN 23-006: prefixes 02 and 20-29 are for restricted circulation within a company or a region

realism.check: Daily demand is noisier than a Poisson process (variance above mean)
realism.source: assumption: daily demand shock, gamma shape 15 (coefficient of variation about 0.26)

realism.check: Staples sell more at weekends and in the first week of the month
realism.detail: weekend x1.20, first week vs last x1.30
realism.source: assumption: weekend peak in modern-trade grocery; assumption: monthly stock-up trips are typical of modern trade (ACNielsen, 2008); placing them in days 1-7 of the month is our assumption

realism.check: Toned milk waste stays between 1% and 8% and gaps under 5% at the usual standing order
UPI is the main tender and some bills cross the Rs 2,000 merchant-fee threshold
realism.detail: UPI 62% of 58,682 bills; 3.5% above Rs 2,000; median Rs 397

realism.check: UPI technical failures run at 0.5-1.0% of attempts outside the Saturday slowdown
realism.source: NPCI MD and CEO Dilip Asbe, November 2024: technical declines are 0.7-0.8% of UPI transactions

realism.check: Every UPI debit that never reaches the store is returned within T+5 days
realism.source: RBI/2019-20/67 (20 Sep 2019), TAT for failed transactions: UPI payments to merchants auto-reversed within T+5, Rs 100 a day after

realism.check: Every scenario faces the same customers and the same four weeks of history
realism.detail: customers identical: True; history identical: True

upi_business_decline.source: assumption: share of UPI attempts declined for the customer's reasons (wrong PIN, balance, limits)

upi_technical_decline.source: NPCI MD and CEO Dilip Asbe, November 2024: technical declines are 0.7-0.8% of UPI transactions

upi_till_timeout.source: assumption: share of UPI attempts that get no answer before the till gives up, on a normal day

upi_slowdown.source: scripted: the acquiring bank's UPI switch slows down on Saturday evening; 40% of attempts get no answer before the till gives up

upi_timeout_debited.source: assumption: share of timed-out attempts where the customer's account was already debited

upi_debited_late_credit.source: assumption: share of those that end as a late credit to the store; the rest are returned to the customer

upi_late_credit_timing.source: assumption: 65% of late credits arrive within 90 seconds of the payment, the rest 1 to 30 hours later, once the payment is confirmed after settlement

upi_return_days.source: assumption: days after the payment that a return reaches the customer, T+1 to T+5. RBI's TAT circular (20 Sep 2019) requires auto-reversal within T+5 for payments to merchants

after_upi_failure.source: assumption: what a customer does when the till says a UPI payment failed

upi_status_check_seconds.source: NPCI UPI OC 215 (2025): first check-transaction-status call no earlier than 90 seconds after the payment

complaint_charged_twice.source: assumption: share of customers charged twice who complain to the store

complaint_debited_returned.source: assumption: share of customers debited and later refunded by their bank who call the store first

manual_refund_days.source: assumption: days to verify and refund a complaint when credits are matched to bills by hand

card_decline.source: assumption: share of first card attempts declined

upi_mdr.source: NPCI UPI and Services Steering Committee, reported 15 Sep 2026: 0.4% MDR on person-to-merchant UPI payments above Rs 2,000, capped at Rs 300, from 15 Oct 2026; merchants receiving up to Rs 1 lakh a month through UPI QR are exempt
